assets.usage: Website preview generated from diagram 1 in solution.tex; editable source remains inline in solution.tex.

diagram_previews.alt: Acute triangle ABC with the gray altitudes BB1 and CC1 and the dashed circle with diameter BC through B1 and C1; E on BB1 with the blue right angle AEC, and F on CC1 with the red right angle AFB.

difficulty_rationale: Needs the observation that F and E are right-angle vertices whose feet on AB and AC are C1 and B1, followed by two similar-triangle relations.
